description: Great-circle and WGS-84 ellipsoidal distance between coordinates — Computes the haversine (IUGG mean-radius sphere) and Vincenty inverse (WGS-84 ellipsoid) distance in metres plus initial and final bearings for up to 100 coordinate pairs, and optionally checks a claimed distance within a tolerance. Vincenty is millimetre-accurate except for nearly antipodal pairs, where it does not converge: those pairs return vincentyMeters null, status unknown and the haversine

claimBasis.description: Which distance claimedMeters is compared against (default vincenty).

name: geo-distance
